name: Chris Wright

lean.basis: Serves in Trump's cabinet and champions fossil-fuel "energy dominance"; no party office or other partisan record found, so Center-right rather than Right.

current_role: U.S. Secretary of Energy (since February 2025); vice chair of the National Energy Dominance Council
summary: Chris Wright founded the Denver fracking-services company Liberty Oilfield Services (now Liberty Energy) in 2011 and ran it as CEO until Trump picked him to lead the Energy Department. The Senate confirmed him 59–38 on February 3, 2025. He is vice chair of the National Energy Dominance Council, chaired by Interior Secretary Doug Burgum.
